name: What's the difference between a tub removal and a tub cut-out service?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a tub removal and a tub cut-out service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tub removal involves completely detaching and disposing of the entire bathtub, leaving an empty space for a new installation or conversion. A tub cut-out service, on the other hand, modifies an existing bathtub by cutting a section out of its side to create a lower step-over entry. This is often done for accessibility purposes, allowing easier access into the tub for individuals with mobility challenges without fully replacing the unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tub removal entirely removes and disposes of the bathtub. A tub cut-out service modifies an existing tub by cutting a section for easier, lower step-over entry, typically for accessibility.
